programs.name: INSPIRE: Investigating Neurosciences Summer Program
programs.org: Indiana University School of Medicine (Stark Neurosciences)
programs.focus: Alzheimer's disease and neurodegeneration research in the Stark Neurosciences Research Institute.

eligibility.notes: Program page says freshman-senior; a press release emphasizes freshmen/sophomores. High school students are not accepted.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open since Oct 1, 2026 and due Jan 15, 2027. Housing is provided if you live outside Indianapolis. No summer courses or outside job during the program.
programs.stipend_note: Competitive stipend; the page does not state an amount

programs.name: Summer Research Training Program
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical and translational research across hospital departments.

eligibility.notes: You need a semester of coursework left after the internship. You pay for your own Act 33, 34 and 73 clearances.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: officially the Summer Research Internship Program (SRIP), due Jan 11, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. The statement of purpose is the only required material. Decisions in March. Same city as Pitt's other programs.
programs.stipend_note: Grant funded; the page does not state an amount

programs.name: Pediatric Oncology Education (POE)
programs.focus: Pediatric cancer and catastrophic disease research. As an undergraduate you get a laboratory or computational placement; clinical research matches are reserved for medical students.
programs.stipend_note: $600 a week before taxes, about $6,600 for the 11 weeks

eligibility.notes: A 3.4 GPA in science and math AND overall. You must already have research experience outside the classroom when you apply, and be able to start on one of the four dates.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open now, due Feb 1, 2027. Housing near campus is free if you come from outside Memphis; travel is yours. Small: 40 students in 2026, 26 of them undergraduates. The 2025 class averaged a 3.88 GPA.
programs.program_dates: Starts May 10, May 17, May 24 or Jun 1, 2027; 11 weeks

programs.name: CHOP Research Institute Summer Scholars Program (CRISSP)
programs.focus: Mentored pediatric biomedical research with a cohort seminar series.

eligibility.notes: Typically rising juniors/seniors; cannot have graduated before the program starts.

programs.notes: The page says applications for summer 2027 open in December; the deadline is not posted yet. Thirty students a summer, with basic, clinical and behavioral tracks and clinical shadowing for everyone. Information sessions: Tuesday, Dec 8 at 11 a.m. and Tuesday, Jan 12 at 3 p.m.
programs.stipend_note: $5,000 plus free housing; need-based travel awards

programs.name: Department of Pediatrics Summer Internship
programs.focus: Pediatric clinical research with Weill Cornell pediatrics faculty.
programs.notes: The page still shows the 2026 cycle (opened Dec 8, 2025, due Jan 5, 2026), so treat Dec 8 as a guess. Seventeen pediatrics projects including child neurology neuroimaging and epilepsy; you can apply to two. No housing, food or travel.
programs.stipend_note: A modest stipend, amount not posted, paid when you finish

programs.name: Research Training & Internships
programs.focus: Multiple pediatric research internship tracks across the institute.
programs.notes: The page still shows the 2026 cycle (applications Dec 1, 2025 to Feb 1, 2026), so 2027 dates are not posted. You rank three mentors in the application. Email ResearchInternship@childrenscolorado.org to ask when 2027 opens.
programs.stipend_note: $4,400 in 2026, meant to cover travel and housing; no housing is provided

programs.name: Undergraduate Developmental Science Summer Internship
programs.focus: Child health research across neuroscience, developmental and clinical areas, run with the Department of Pediatrics.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the form opens Dec 1, 2026 and closes Jan 14, 2027 at 5 p.m. ET, with no late applications and no extensions. Eight weeks, 40 hours a week, in person in New Haven, up to 12 places. Two academic letters, a one page letter of interest, a two page resume and proof of summer health insurance. No housing.
programs.stipend_note: Up to $4,000, and only if you cannot get funding from Penn State first

programs.name: Pediatric Epilepsy Research Internship (Loddenkemper Lab)
programs.focus: Pediatric epilepsy and EEG research in a single high-output lab.
programs.notes: Unpaid, 30 hours a week, with a remote option. Send questions only to LoddenkemperInternship@childrens.harvard.edu, not to lab members. The page still shows last cycle's dates, so check it from early January.
programs.stipend_note: Unpaid: you need academic credit from your school or outside funding

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Internship Program (SURIP)
programs.focus: Bench biomedical research across Penn State College of Medicine departments, aimed at students headed to a PhD, with no clinical component.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED date: Feb 1, 2027. The page says SURIP is for students considering a PhD and is not intended for students planning on medical school, and there is no clinical shadowing. Up to 8 interns. Last cycle's cutoff was noon Eastern, so finish the morning before.
programs.stipend_note: At least $5,500 before taxes; if you live on campus, July rent is paid and June and August are yours

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF), Biomedical Research
programs.focus: Ten weeks of mentored biomedical research at Mayo Clinic with a strong professional-development core.

eligibility.notes: Must have completed sophomore year by program start.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the window runs Nov 1, 2026 to Feb 3, 2027. You pick a research area when you apply, and neuroscience is one. About 180 undergraduates a year across three campuses; the Arizona and Florida tracks have their own pages.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Internship Program (SUIP)
programs.org: University of Pennsylvania: Biomedical Graduate Studies
programs.focus: Biomedical research at Penn Med with PhD-track mentoring and graduate-school prep.

eligibility.notes: Oriented toward students planning a PhD or MD-PhD.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open since Oct 1, 2026 and due Feb 1, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. ET. Your letters must arrive by that same deadline, which is unusual, so ask early. Built for students heading to a PhD. You can also apply through the Leadership Alliance portal.

programs.name: Summer Internship Program (Pathway)
programs.focus: Mentored biomedical research at Johns Hopkins School of Medicine.
programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: opened Nov 1, 2026 and closes Feb 1, 2027 at 11:59 p.m. EST. Housing is free and the stipend varies by division. There is a NeuroSIP division, and you may apply to several divisions. Unofficial transcripts are fine. Applying is free.
programs.stipend_note: Varies by division; housing is free

programs.name: Heart, Lung and Blood (HLB) Summer Research Program
programs.org: Case Western Reserve University School of Medicine
programs.focus: NHLBI-aligned cardiovascular, pulmonary and hematologic research.
programs.notes: Same institution as CanSUR. Check whether one application covers both.

programs.name: Cancer-focused Summer Undergraduate Research (CanSUR)
programs.focus: Cancer biology and cancer health-disparities research.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship (SURF)
programs.focus: Pediatric biomedical research at one of the largest children's research institutes.
programs.notes: Flagged on your list as OPEN NOW. Top-tier pediatric research fit.

programs.name: Student Research Programs
programs.focus: Campus-level undergraduate research program listings.
programs.notes: The weakest entry on your list unless you have an ODU connection. This is a general campus page, not a competitive national program.

programs.name: Mechanistic Biology Summer Program (MBSP)
programs.focus: Mechanistic cancer biology in Sloan Kettering Institute labs.

eligibility.notes: Undergraduate program, separate from MSK's high school HOPP. Research experience is expected, plus college biology and introductory chemistry. Must be vaccinated and boosted against COVID-19.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the portal opened Nov 2, 2026 and closes Feb 1, 2027 at 8:00 a.m., a morning cutoff. Official transcripts from every school you attended. Offers by Mar 15.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program
programs.focus: Biomedical research across MUSC colleges.

programs.name: Summer Undergraduate Research Program (SURP)
programs.focus: Biomedical research at NYU Langone with PhD-pipeline mentoring.

eligibility.notes: You need at least one full semester of bench lab research.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: open now, due Feb 2, 2027 at 5 p.m. ET. About 30 students a summer.
programs.stipend_note: $5,000 plus free housing and round-trip travel; you pay for food

programs.name: AHA Undergraduate Summer Fellowship (AHA-USF)
programs.focus: American Heart Association-funded cardiovascular and stroke research in a basic science lab, with no clinical shadowing.
programs.notes: Opens Dec 1, 2026. Everything, your letter and transcript included, must arrive by NOON Eastern on Feb 15, 2027, not end of day. Up to 6 students. You are a Penn State student, so you apply as an internal candidate. Same campus as SURIP and PROMISE.
programs.stipend_note: $6,000 before taxes; housing in Hershey is yours to pay

programs.name: Neuroscience & Cell Biology Summer Research
programs.org: Rutgers Robert Wood Johnson Medical School
programs.focus: Neuroscience and cell biology research in RWJMS labs.
programs.notes: Flagged on your list: opens Jan 2.
programs.link_note: This site blocks automated link checks, so the watcher cannot verify it. Open it in a browser.

programs.name: Summer Biomedical Research Program (SBRP)
programs.org: East Carolina University: Brody School of Medicine
programs.focus: Basic science research at the Brody School of Medicine and ECU Health, with lab safety training and career workshops.

eligibility.notes: Undergraduates. An older ECU document describes the program as targeting students from underrepresented, low-socioeconomic or rural backgrounds. Confirm current rules on the page.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: the 2027 cycle is open now and closes Feb 12, 2027. The program runs May 24 - Jul 23, 2027. The page posts no stipend or housing, so ask before you count on either.

programs.name: PROMISE: Research Training in Oncology and Medicine to Inspire Student Engagement
programs.org: Penn State College of Medicine / Penn State Cancer Institute
programs.focus: NCI-funded, team-based cancer research with weekly career-development sessions, ending in a poster symposium.

eligibility.notes: STEM majors who have completed at least two years of college, rising juniors and seniors. Engineering, computer science, statistics and biological sciences all count. Students underrepresented in the biomedical workforce are encouraged to apply.

programs.notes: CONFIRMED on the page: closes Jan 31, 2027. A 3.0 GPA is recommended, not required. Up to 22 students, undergraduates and medical students together. Optional clinical shadowing. Of the three Hershey programs this is the cheapest to attend. Ask whether one application can be considered for more than one.
programs.stipend_note: $6,000 for 10 weeks, travel to Hershey covered, partial need-based housing support
